verdict.rationale: Lithic documents a single create-card endpoint for virtual or physical cards, and a production-mirroring sandbox where cards can be run end-to-end (also shown in its MCP walkthrough creating a virtual card). The evidence never shows PAN, CVV, and expiry returned programmatically at issuance, and nothing shows a self-serve path from sandbox to live. missing for 10: evidence that PAN/CVV/expiry are returned in the create response, a documented self-serve production go-live without a sales cycle, independent hands-on corroboration.
